title: Place-it-R1: Unlocking Environment-aware Reasoning Potential of MLLM for Video Object Insertion
abstract: arXiv:2603.06140v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video object insertion is fundamental to video editing, yet existing diffusion methods often produce visually plausible but physically inconsistent results. We present Place-it-R1, an end-to-end framework for physically plausible video object insertion driven by environment-aware MLLM reasoning. Rather than treating reasoning as a generic text prompt, Place-it-R1 uses the MLLM to analyze the target environment, infer object-scene interactions, and determine where an insertion is physically valid. The resulting reasoning is translated into two complementary forms of guidance for video diffusion: semantic guidance that describes the intended physical interaction and spatial guidance that provides a valid insertion region in each frame. translated_title: Place-it-R1：释放多模态大语言模型在视频物体插入中的环境感知推理潜力
translated_abstract: 视频物体插入是视频编辑的基础任务，然而现有的扩散模型方法往往产生视觉上看似合理但物理上不一致的结果。我们提出了Place-it-R1，一个由环境感知的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理驱动的端到端框架，用于实现物理上合理的视频物体插入。Place-it-R1并不将推理视为通用的文本提示，而是利用MLLM分析目标环境、推断物体与场景之间的交互，并确定插入在物理上有效的位置。由此产生的推理被转化为两种互补的视频扩散引导形式：描述预期物理交互的语义引导，以及在每一帧中提供有效插入区域的空间引导。为了进一步使生成结果符合局部物理真实性，我们引入了空间直接偏好优化，利用MLLM对生成的候选结果进行排序，并引入了一种区域感知的预……
tldr: Place-it-R1提出了一种由环境感知MLLM推理驱动的端到端视频物体插入框架，通过语义与空间双重引导以及空间直接偏好优化，实现了物理上合理且与环境一致的视频物体插入效果。
en_tdlr: Place-it-R1 is an end-to-end video object insertion framework driven by environment-aware MLLM reasoning, which combines semantic and spatial guidance with Spatial Direct Preference Optimization to achieve physically plausible insertion results.
